title: Squirrel holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 42 Q58 50 55 56' stroke='#f4f4f4' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='30' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#e63b3b'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='30' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff8f8f' stroke-width='1.6'/>

  <polygon points='64,44 61,48 67,48' fill='#c22e2e'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q16 54 20 40 Q24 30 34 34 Q30 44 36 50 Q42 56 40 64 Z' fill='#c96a1e'/>
  <path d='M26 42 Q30 36 33 38' stroke='#f0a15a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='64' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#e07a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='68' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#ffe0b0'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#c96a1e'/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='82' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e07a2a'/>

  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='14' fill='#e07a2a'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#e07a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='31' rx='2.2' ry='3.5' fill='#ffcf9a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='29' rx='4.5' ry='6' fill='#e07a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='30' rx='2.2' ry='3.5' fill='#ffcf9a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='47' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#ffe0b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='2.8' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='38' r='2.8' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='43.9' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53.9' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#5a3218'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M48 46 Q45 49 43.5 47.5 M48 46 Q51 49 52.5 47.5' stroke='#8a4a1e' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
